name: Elsa Bloodstone

abilityDetails.Degeneration: Rakibe zamanla doğrudan, engellenemez hasar verir.
abilityDetails.Counter-Attack Evade: Rakip saldırılarından otomatik olarak kaçmayı sağlar.
abilityDetails.Incinerate: Zamanla enerji tabanlı yakma hasarı verir ve zırhı yok sayar.
abilityDetails.Coldsnap: Ani soğuk hasarı verir ve düşmanın Kaçış yeteneğini kapatır.

howToPlay: Elsa Bloodstone için oynanış rehberi: Özel saldırılarını kullanarak rakiplerini alt edin. Komboları düzgün zamanlayarak siper alın.
bestUse: Bu şampiyon genel maceralarda ve Skill sınıfı avantajı olan yollarda en iyi performansı gösterir.
signatureAbility:
Huntress of The Contest
When Fighting Science Champions, Critical Hits with Hellfire Rounds deal an additional [2,639.71 - 15,838.45] damage.
When Fighting #Large or #Extra Large Champions, Critical Hits with Behemoth Busters deal an additional [2,639.71 - 15,838.45] damage.
Elsa's Critical Damage Rating is increased by [144.73 - 1,178.57] when fighting the final node in a Quest.

abilitySections.title: Bloodgem Protection
content: When Elsa is affected by a Bleed Debuff, Non-Mutant Champions gain a Passive Degeneration dealing [1,267.08] Direct Damage every 0.5 seconds until all Bleed Debuffs on Elsa end. While this Degen is active Opponents will also be passively Heal Blocked.
While suffering from a Non-Damaging Debuff, Elsa has a 100% chance to Purify 1 of any Debuff every 2.6 seconds.
After Purifying a Debuff, Elsa gains a Precision Buff increasing Critical Rating by [2,750] for 9 seconds.

abilitySections.title: Well Timed Blocks
content: When Elsa would perform a Well-Timed Block against Basic Attacks, she has a 100% chance to Evade instead. This Evade has a cooldown of 11 seconds.
When performing an Evade, Elsa counter attacks with her Revolver and deals [1,583.85] Physical Damage on Hit. This attack generates no Power for the Opponent.

abilitySections.title: Enhanced Munitions
content: Elsa loads her Winchester with Hellfire Rounds and her Revolvers with Behemoth Busters. Each gun can fire 6 rounds before Reloading.
Reloading lasts 11 seconds. Each stack of Reloading increases Elsa's Offensive Combat Power Rate by 40%.

abilitySections.title: Winchester: Hellfire Rounds (Medium Combo Ender and Special 1)
content: On Hit: Inflict an Incinerate Debuff, dealing [5,279.5] Energy Damage over 11 seconds. This also removes Perfect Block Chance and reduces Block Proficiency by 50%. Winchester shots are projectiles and do not make contact.
If the Opponent has triggered an Evade or they are Immune to Incinerate, a matching Coldsnap Debuff is inflicted instead, which prevents Evade from activating.

abilitySections.title: Revolver: Behemoth Busters (Light Combo Ender and Special 2)
content: On Hit: Inflict a Busted Debuff, increasing the Potency of incoming Incinerate or Coldsnap Debuffs by 50% for 21 seconds. Additionally, each time the Opponent is Struck by a Critical Hit, deal [2,639.75] Direct Damage for each Busted Debuff. This Damage scales with base attack only. Revolver shots are projectiles and do not make contact.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 1
content: On Activation gain a Precision Buff increasing Critical Rating by [4,125] for 9 seconds. This Precision is paused until Elsa activates her next Special Attack.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 2
content: If Elsa runs out of Behemoth Busters she will fire her Hellfire Rounds instead.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 3
content: Gain up to 3 Cruelty Buffs, each increasing Elsa's Critical Damage Rating by [305.56] for 22 seconds.
These Cruelty Buffs expire 1 at a time. Each time Elsa triggers a Reloading effect, she refreshes their duration.
